The '''HS-14 hoverskiff''' was a model of [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] that was developed by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] for use as a cargo hauler. They were versatile and saw use on various backwater worlds, particularly on farms and in rural areas. A number saw service with the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> and in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> the CSA deployed several HS-14 hoverskiffs on the streets of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tel Bollin]], on the quarantined [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endregaad]].<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
